_readme: Every BusterElectric station the map shows. Add one object per site.
connectors: type is CCS1, NACS or J1772; level is dc (fast) or l2 (Level 2). kw is optional.
'available' is optional. Leave it out when live availability isn't known; the map then points drivers to the E-Fill Electric app for live status.
For live availability, set liveStatusUrl to an endpoint that returns { "<station id>": { "<connector type>": <available count> } }.
